question.text: The position x of an object changes with time t according to the relationship √x = t + 3. Which of the following statements about its motion is correct?

options.1: velocity of the particle is inversely proportional to t
options.2: velocity of particle varies linearly with t
options.3: velocity of particle is proportional to √t
options.4: initial velocity of the particle is zero

solution.approach: Square both sides to write displacement as a function of time, then differentiate to find how velocity depends on time.

steps.text: Square both sides of the given relation to write x as a function of t.
Differentiate x with respect to t to get the velocity.
This expression is of the form v = 2t + 6, which is a straight line in t, so velocity varies linearly with time.
Check the initial velocity at t = 0 to rule out the other options.
steps.equation: v(0) = 2(0) + 6 = 6 ms⁻¹, not zero, not inversely proportional to t, and not proportional to √t

final_answer.value: velocity of particle varies linearly with t

common_mistakes.text: Differentiating t² + 6t + 9 but dropping the 6t term by mistake, leaving v = 2t, which gives v(0) = 0 instead of the correct 6 ms⁻¹.

concept_tags: velocity as a function of time
